long_description:
Fathom Health is an AI company that automates medical coding by reading clinical documentation and suggesting appropriate diagnosis and procedure codes. Their deep learning technology processes physician notes and extracts billable information, reducing the manual effort required from coding staff.

The platform integrates with major EHR systems to access clinical documentation and deliver coding suggestions within existing workflows. Fathom's AI is trained on large datasets of coded medical records and continuously improves based on coder feedback.

Fathom serves health systems and large medical groups dealing with coding backlogs, coder shortages, or accuracy concerns. The technology is particularly valuable for organizations processing high volumes of inpatient and outpatient encounters.

As an enterprise solution focused on coding automation, Fathom is designed for organizations with dedicated coding teams rather than individual practitioners or small practices handling their own billing.
best_for: Large medical groups seeking coding accuracy improvements
Revenue cycle teams processing high encounter volumes
not_for: Organizations seeking clinical documentation AI scribes
Mental health practices with simpler coding needs
